# A selected global store does not associate an unrelated checkout.
mkdir global-store
mkdir unrelated
cd unrelated
env CARDAMOM_STORE=$WORK/global-store
stdin $WORK/input/session-start.json
exec card hook context
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists $WORK/global-store/board.sqlite3

# A local Cardamom entry activates context without opening a database.
mkdir .cardamom
stdin $WORK/input/session-start.json
exec card hook context
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/session-start.json
! stderr .
! exists .cardamom/board.sqlite3

# A non-Git checkout board binding also activates subagent context.
cd ..
mkdir plain
exec sh -c 'printf "board_00000000000000000000\n" > plain/.cardamom-board'
cd plain
stdin $WORK/input/subagent-start.json
exec card hook context
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/subagent-start.json
! stderr .

# Git checkout bindings activate the primary checkout and linked worktrees that
# inherit the primary binding.
cd ..
mkdir repo
exec git -C repo init -b main
exec sh -c 'printf "initial\n" > repo/README.md'
exec git -C repo add README.md
exec git -C repo commit -m initial
exec sh -c 'printf "board_00000000000000000000\n" > repo/.git/cardamom-board'
cd repo
stdin $WORK/input/session-start.json
exec card hook context
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/session-start.json
! stderr .
exec git worktree add ../linked -b linked
cd ../linked
stdin $WORK/input/subagent-start.json
exec card hook context
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/subagent-start.json
! stderr .
! exists .cardamom

# Malformed and unsupported hook input fail open without output.
stdin $WORK/input/malformed.json
exec card hook context
! stdout .
! stderr .
stdin $WORK/input/unsupported.json
exec card hook context
! stdout .
! stderr .

-- input/session-start.json --
{"hook_event_name":"SessionStart","source":"startup"}
-- input/subagent-start.json --
{"hook_event_name":"SubagentStart","agent_type":"Explore"}
-- input/malformed.json --
{
-- input/unsupported.json --
{"hook_event_name":"Stop"}
-- golden/session-start.json --
{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"Load and follow the Cardamom skill for work in this checkout."}}
-- golden/subagent-start.json --
{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SubagentStart","additionalContext":"Load and follow the Cardamom skill for work in this checkout."}}
